# Verify the Costas array
def verify_costas(perm):
    n = len(perm)
    vectors = set()
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1, n):
            dc = j - i
            dr = perm[j] - perm[i]
            vec = (dc, dr)
            if vec in vectors:
                print(f"Duplicate vector: {vec} between ({i},{perm[i]}) and ({j},{perm[j]})")
                return False
            vectors.add(vec)
    
    expected_count = n * (n - 1) // 2
    print(f"Number of unique vectors: {len(vectors)} (expected {expected_count})")
    print("All vectors are distinct!")
    return True

perm = [0, 1, 4, 8, 3, 10, 9, 6, 2, 7, 5]
